speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In January 2016, shortly after the SG50 year, my predecessor President Tony Tan opened the 13th Parliament.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Dr Tan reviewed how far we had come as a nation.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: He renewed our commitment to keep Singapore an exceptional nation, with a thriving economy and a caring and inclusive society.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are now midway through the current term of Government.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: It has been an eventful 32 months: the United States (US) elected a new President; the Chinese Communist Party held its 19th National Congress; the United Kingdom voted to leave the European Union; and the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) became a significant menace, though it has since been dealt a severe blow.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Singapore has navigated a steady path amidst an uncertain external environment.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We continued to uphold the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) centrality and unity.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are making progress in renewing our economy.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We sped up the upgrading of the North-South and East-West MRT lines.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are improving the reliability of our trains.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We continued to strive for a more caring and inclusive society.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We rejoiced when Joseph Schooling won Singapore’s first Olympic gold medal, and when Yip Pin Xiu and Theresa Goh triumphed at the Rio Paralympics.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We celebrated National Service (NS)50 and saluted over a million NSmen who have served their nation through the decades.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: I am honoured to serve as the first Malay President in 47 years after Encik Yusof Ishak.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: I renew today the pledge that I made when I took my oath of office in September last year: I will serve every Singaporean, regardless of race, language or religion.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: These steps were necessary to strengthen our long-term fiscal position, ready us for an ageing population, and fund infrastructure investments on a sustainable basis.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: As your President, I will safeguard our Reserves and ensure that they are drawn upon properly and only under exceptional circumstances, or for other very good reasons.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The Government is fulfilling the tasks it set out to accomplish; relations with partners around the world are good; people live harmoniously with one another; and economic prospects are bright.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: But do not assume that Singapore will always continue to be successful.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: There are significant developments in our external and domestic environments that we must understand and deal with.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The centre of gravity of the world economy is shifting to Asia, as a result of China rising and India taking off.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: ASEAN, our immediate neighbourhood, is generating renewed interest among international investors.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: But much depends on the relationship between the US and China, which underpins regional and global peace and prosperity.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Both powers have high stakes in maintaining a stable and healthy relationship.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: As China’s strength grows and America’s interests evolve, both sides will need to manage the inevitable rivalries and disagreements, and exercise foresight and restraint.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Trade frictions are just one aspect of US-China bilateral tensions that affect the rest of the world, especially small, open economies like ours.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The Korean Peninsula is currently seeing fresh and positive developments, but it is a complex problem with a long history.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Negotiations towards a peaceful resolution and, ultimately, the denuclearisation of the Peninsula, will be complex and difficult.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: ISIS has lost the military battle in Iraq and Syria, but the extremist ideology behind it has not been eradicated.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Southeast Asian fighters who joined ISIS in the Middle East may return home to mount attacks in and around their home countries.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We must stay vigilant and united and never allow a terrorist attack to cause discord and distrust among us.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In particular, we must be careful of the dangers of online radicalisation.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Closer to home, relations with our immediate neighbours – Malaysia and Indonesia – are stable and multifaceted.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We have grown our partnerships in recent years and will continue to strengthen them.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We must tend these bilateral relationships carefully, especially during election seasons, and avoid becoming embroiled in their domestic politics.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The texture of our society is changing as our population ages.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: This will place heavier demands on our healthcare and social security systems.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We have seen income inequality and social stratification break the social compact in many countries.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Religious polarisation, xenophobia and extreme nationalism are also divisive forces that have grown stronger in many parts of the world.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The cyber space is being used to spread falsehoods and misinformation, and to sow distrust within societies.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We must not allow our nation to succumb to these forces.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: All these developments that I have outlined can affect us in unexpected ways.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We need to watch them closely, tackle them resolutely, and make progress together.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We already have policies and programmes to respond to these shifts.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: These tasks will occupy us beyond this term of Government.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: A small, multicultural city-state, with no natural resources, in the heart of Southeast Asia, must survive and thrive on the wits and will of its people.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: At the same time, the new leaders are conscious that Singapore is at quite an advanced stage of development.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We may feel that we have more to lose now.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We may be tempted not to go for bold changes but instead be content to tweak things at the margins.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: It is a vibrant global node in the heart of a thriving Asia; a multicultural society with people from diverse backgrounds living harmoniously side by side.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We need to keep alive the spirit of our Pioneers and be constantly driven to do better, with each generation surpassing the previous.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Together, they will build upon what earlier generations accomplished.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: They will fashion new ideas and fresh approaches to confront a different future.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are beginning to see the imprint of the new leadership in developing and implementing public policies.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Over time, these policies will be elaborated, refined and will produce results.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The work has begun and will intensify from the second half of this term of Government.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: First, we want to secure Singapore's place in this changing world.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: To do so, we are prepared to stand and fight for our nation, defend our vital interests, and work with others in win-win partnerships.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The Singapore Armed Forces and Home Team are steadily building up their capabilities, including against unconventional threats like terrorism and cyberattacks.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Beyond equipment and capabilities, our strength ultimately lies in our people's resolve to defend this country and be masters of our destiny.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: As a small globalised city, we must uphold international law and the role of supranational institutions.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Against the tide of rising protectionism, we must champion free trade and explore new opportunities to collaborate with others.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We seek to be friends with as many countries as possible.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The US has been a constructive and stabilising presence in the region for the past 70 years.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: It remains an important strategic partner for Singapore.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We cooperate with the US in many areas and will enhance this cooperation in the years ahead.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Our relationship with China is deep and productive.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In Southeast Asia, we will strive for an open and inclusive regional order, with all the major powers engaged.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will work with regional partners to strengthen ASEAN centrality and unity and do our part to prevent the build-up of tensions in the South China Sea.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: This year, we are the ASEAN chair, but we will sustain our efforts for the long term.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Second, Singaporeans want to live in a world-class city and an endearing home – clean, green and efficient; fun and connected; and we are prepared to think long term in planning our city and infrastructure and building for future generations.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will invest in infrastructure to keep Singapore one of the best-connected cities in Asia, a hub and conduit for the flow of goods and services, capital and people, information and knowledge.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are building Changi Airport Terminal 5 and a new Tuas Port.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail and the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link will open up business opportunities and draw our two peoples closer.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Beyond physical links, we will also develop Singapore as a node in the global flow of data.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are renewing our Housing and Development Board heartlands and investing heavily in new MRT infrastructure.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are making this a car-lite city, with vibrant public spaces and pathways for walking and cycling.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are working with Singaporeans to create a greener and better living environment, a City in a Garden.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will do our part to reduce carbon emissions.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: A far-reaching transformation of Singapore's cityscape will take shape in the coming decades.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The possibilities in this new area – the Greater Southern Waterfront – are immense and limited only by our imagination.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: With bold thinking, we will create a metropolis that embraces the future.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Third, Singaporeans want our city to remain a nation of opportunities, where we can pursue dreams, chart fulfilling careers and lead meaningful lives.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: To achieve this, we are prepared to adapt to changing economic conditions, embrace technology and continually upgrade our skills and knowledge.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will continue to renew the economy to keep it productive, enterprising and innovative.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Our investment in research and development is bearing fruit and will enable us to exploit deep technology and digitalisation; create a Smart Nation; and conceive, testbed and scale up new products and services.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: This innovation ecosystem will strongly support entrepreneurship and further develop the startup scene in artificial intelligence, financial technology, advanced manufacturing, bioscience and other areas.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: New business centres, such as the Jurong Lake District, Punggol Digital District, and Woodlands North Coast, will each have its own character and industry niche.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Companies will play a major role in economic restructuring.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will build a strong base of local firms with the capabilities to succeed both at home and abroad.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Our enterprises must develop a strong culture of collaboration, especially when overseas.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Singapore Inc must be a force abroad as much as it is at home.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In an age of technological disruption, Singaporeans must be flexible, eager to learn, and adventurous to venture beyond our shores.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are changing the way we educate and prepare Singaporeans for life, putting less emphasis on academic grades, and more on skills and the ability to adapt to a dynamic external environment.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Unions, employers and the Government must continue to collaborate closely.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Tripartism has been an enduring competitive advantage for Singapore, and we have to continually nurture and strengthen it.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Fourth, Singaporeans want to live in a fair and just society, one based on meritocracy but, at the same time, strives to leave no one behind.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Thus, we are each prepared to do our best, but also to walk alongside fellow citizens who need help to keep up.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In Singapore, people must always be able to get ahead through effort and excellence.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We must open up more progression pathways and celebrate a broader range of successes.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We are committed to give every child a good start in life, no matter what their family circumstances may be.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will continue to raise the quality of preschools and do more for children at risk.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We need to provide the right additional support to those needing it – in housing, education, skills training and employment – so that meritocracy works well.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Only then can everyone do well through hard work, talent and skills, regardless of their background.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We need to pay special attention to the growing population of the elderly.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will continue to help older workers stay employed, earn fair wages and save more, so that they can age with dignity and purpose.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The Government will do its part to meet the needs of different segments of Singaporeans.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: It will provide more support to young families and make Singapore a great place to have children; help families cope with the cost of living; and enable persons with disabilities to lead full and active lives.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Most importantly, we need to build a strong culture where the better-off devote time, talent and resources to help the less fortunate.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Only when everybody lends a helping hand, can we truly become a compassionate and caring society.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Above all, Singaporeans want to feel a strong sense of nationhood.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: That is why we are prepared to participate in and enlarge our common space, while preserving and practising our own ethnic cultures.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Through the education system, we adopted a common working language in English.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: NS has become a key institution for nation-building and a major part of the Singaporean identity.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: By living and working side by side, going through ups and downs together, our diverse cultures and traditions are now interwoven.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We did not expect this on 8 August 1965, but we have succeeded in nurturing a distinct Singapore identity, a sense of common destiny transcending our individual racial and religious identities.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: This is still a work in progress, but we have come far.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: We will reflect on what it means to be Singaporean, and on the common values and beliefs that bind us together.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In an uncertain and volatile world, leadership will continue to make a critical difference to Singapore.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: In responding to the challenges of their times, the fourth-generation leaders will work in concert with Singaporeans.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: A new generation of Singaporeans is coming of age.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Their dreams, hopes and fears are different from those of their parents and grandparents.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: They dream of a bright future and pour their energies into exploring fresh horizons and building a better world.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: They want to see their parents age well.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: They hope for a fairer and more equal society.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: As proud Singaporeans, they want to see this small island nation stand tall amongst the community of nations.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Most of all, they are eager to take on responsibilities, participate in building and guiding Singapore, and step up to serve their community and country.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Their duty is clear, but the path will not be easy.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: There will be times of hardship, when they must demonstrate leadership and resolve.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: This is how they will earn the right to lead.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: After 52 years, we are not done building our nation.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: The struggle for Independence, the journey from Third World to First, are gradually fading from our lived memories, as a new generation comes to the fore.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Born and raised in post-Independence Singapore, they must dedicate themselves to write the next chapter of our story, understanding that becoming Singaporean – "one united people, regardless of race, language or religion" – continues to be an undertaking of conviction and choice.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: Together, the new generation will keep Singapore an exceptional nation.

speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
text: ADDENDA TO THE PRESIDENT'S ADDRESS AT THE OPENING OF THE SECOND SESSION OF THE 13TH PARLIAMENT ON MONDAY, 7 MAY 2018
